correctness.rationale: Exact stationary reversal follows from interval transports; component two-step smoothing gives density \(3M^n\), recurrence \(M(M^2-J)=-(M^2-J)/2\) gives \(\psi_n=2^{2-n}\), and a positive alternating deterministic word in \(Q^n\) forces unbounded joint/product ratio for arbitrarily small source intervals. An all-P word in \(Q^3\) provides uniform Doeblin constant \(3/32\) and exponential total-variation mixing. Independent exact-rational finite verification passed 445 checks; all-lag theorem uses explicit induction/word proof.

value.rationale: An explicit counterexample settles the unrestricted copula psi-mixing convex closure question posed in a 2022 primary article. Stronger structure (transposed inputs, reversible average, exponential psi coefficient for each input, Doeblin uniform ergodicity for average) isolates a meaningful rare-event singularity mechanism separating phi/beta mixing from psi mixing.
